ig_caption:
50 tools or 5? I tested it 🧪

Same small model (qwen2.5 3B), 10 real requests:
✅ 5 tools: 9/10 correct
✅ 50 tools: also 9/10. It didn't get dumber.

But every tool description goes into every request:
💸 5 tools: ~347 prompt tokens
💸 50 tools: ~2,163. That's 6x more context on every call.
And the one new miss: get_shipment instead of get_order, because two tools overlapped.

Fix: remove overlaps, and load tools only when a task needs them.

Part 4/5 of MCP & Tools. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.

#MCP #AIAgents #GenAI #LLM #AIArchitect
